system.description: Once per turn, when you deal both Cold and Lightning damage to a creature, you can crystalize the charged lightning in the air around them. Until the end of your next turn, if that creature willingly moves more than 5 feet, or casts a jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, they take three times your Laser Circus attacks damage and must make a Constitution saving throw, being Stunned, until the end of their current turn on a failure.
